name: zungun
description: Android SDK for reliable offline-first delivery of critical field operations, with idempotency, reconciliation, and verifiable execution evidence.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/build/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test:core: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/protocol-core.test.js dist/tests/oracle-differential.test.js
scripts.test:receiver: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/receiver-integration.test.js dist/tests/migrations.test.js
scripts.test:security: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/receipts.test.js dist/tests/security-boundaries.test.js
scripts.verify:deep: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:oracle && npm test && npm run test:resilience && npm run benchmark:assurance && npm run verify:pack && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:no-placeholders && npm run verify:secrets && npm run verify:security-evidence
scripts.test:witness: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/witness.test.js dist/tests/witness-receiver.test.js dist/tests/witness-verifier-cli.test.js dist/tests/server-api.test.js
scripts.test:link-security: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/link-security-negative.test.js dist/tests/link-proxy.test.js
scripts.verify:link-vectors: npm run build && node tools/link-vectors/generate.mjs .tmp/link-planner-v1.vectors && cmp .tmp/link-planner-v1.vectors testdata/link-planner-v1.vectors
scripts.test:link-resilience: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/link-resilience-matrix.test.js dist/tests/link-blackout.test.js
